capabilities: sync ThoughtFree thoughts into vault notes on open and every 30 minutes
map ThoughtFree categories to folders of your choice
write category, kind, tags and dates as note properties for Bases and search
copy photos, PDFs and voice clips into the vault as attachments
mark thoughts trashed through a property instead of deleting notes
extras: Account sign-in is read-only (thoughts, comments, categories, attachments; never the diary). If another sync service copies the vault, the plugin's sync must be left on on only one device. Security issues go to support@thoughtfree.io rather than public issues. Clipped web content is sanitized so it cannot execute or fetch in the vault. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: ThoughtFree thoughts live in an outside service, so Obsidian users cannot keep them as local, editable notes with searchable properties.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks to one service, ThoughtFree, at mcp.thoughtfree.io, to sign in and to read what changed.

summary: Read-only connector that syncs ThoughtFree thoughts into vault notes, one note per thought, organized into category folders with properties for Bases.
